name: Calculo del Indice de Masa Corporal (IMC)
description:
El IMC es una medida de la grasa corporal basada en la estatura y el peso que se aplica a hombres y mujeres adultos. Las categorias de IMC son las siguientes:
Bajo peso = <18.5
Peso normal = 18.5–24.9
Sobrepeso = 25–29.9
Obesidad = IMC de 30 o mayor.
La formula del IMC (sistema imperial) es: IMC = (Peso en libras / (Altura en pulgadas x Altura en pulgadas)) x 703.
Construya un programa que calcule el Indice de Masa Corporal (IMC) de acuerdo con esta formula.
untr_description:
BMI is a measure of body fat based on height and weight that applies to adult men and women. BMI Categories are as follows:
Underweight = <18.5
Normal weight = 18.5–24.9
Overweight = 25–29.9
Obesity = BMI of 30 or greater.
English BMI Formula (Imperial) is: BMI = (Weight in Pounds / (Height in inches x Height in inches)) x 703.
Construct a program that calculates the Body Mass Index (BMI) according to this formula.

distractors.description: Podrías elegir este distractor si crees equivocadamente que la formula del IMC puede simplificarse dividiendo el peso por la altura directamente, sin elevar la altura al cuadrado. Esta idea equivocada suele surgir por no comprender completamente el requisito de elevar la altura al cuadrado antes de dividir. Usar este distractor resultaria en un valor de IMC mucho mayor al esperado, ya que no se tiene en cuenta el cuadrado de la altura, que es crucial para el calculo correcto. Esta linea simplifica incorrectamente la formula, llevando a resultados de IMC incorrectos.
distractors.untr_description: You might choose this distractor if you mistakenly believe that the BMI formula can be simplified by dividing weight by height directly, without squaring the height. This misconception often arises from not fully understanding the formula's requirement to square the height before dividing. Using this distractor would result in a much larger BMI value than expected, as it does not account for the height being squared, which is crucial for the correct calculation. This line incorrectly simplifies the formula, leading to incorrect BMI results.

distractors.description: Este distractor podria parecer correcto si piensas que multiplicar el peso por 703 primero es equivalente al orden correcto de operaciones. Sin embargo, esta reorganizacion no cambia el resultado matematico si se considera la asociatividad y precedencia correctamente; aun asi, en terminos conceptuales la formula requiere dividir el peso por el cuadrado de la altura primero y luego multiplicar por 703. Usar este distractor podria causar confusion sobre el orden de operaciones, aunque matematicamente puede dar el mismo resultado si se evalua con aritmetica de punto flotante; aun asi, representa una apreciacion incorrecta del flujo logico de la formula y puede inducir a errores en calculos mas complejos.
distractors.untr_description: This distractor might seem correct if you think that multiplying weight by 703 first is equivalent to the correct order of operations. However, this rearrangement changes the calculation's outcome because it alters the sequence in which operations are performed. The formula requires dividing weight by the square of height first, then multiplying by 703. Using this distractor would lead to a different BMI value, as it incorrectly prioritizes multiplication over the necessary division, resulting in an inaccurate calculation.

La formula correcta pretende dividir el peso por el cuadrado de la altura primero, y luego multiplicar por 703. Este distractor podria producir el mismo resultado que la linea correcta en muchos casos, pero representa un flujo logico mal expresado, lo que puede llevar a malentendidos en calculos mas complejos.
distractors.untr_description: You might select this distractor if you believe that the order of multiplication doesn't affect the outcome. While multiplication is commutative, the placement of operations in this formula is crucial. This distractor incorrectly places the multiplication with 703 at the beginning, which can lead to confusion about the intended order of operations. The correct formula requires dividing weight by the square of height first, then multiplying by 703. This distractor would yield the same result as the correct line, but it misrepresents the logical flow of the formula, which can lead to misunderstandings in more complex calculations.
